$comment: Specialist actions (ruleset v0; spec S2 section 14, settled 2026-11-07; numbers are proposals). Settled in the brief: only specialist types shape the world, each by its own fixed rule (2026-10-10); actions show as markers on the regiment's lane; edits write the shared grids; every result leaves gaps for every class and stays clearable (each edit batch passes the reachability check or is skipped); charges are lost when the regiment is wiped or routs; the 100 m rule binds the god, not soldiers. common: an enemy outline within pauseWhenEnemyWithinMm pauses the action, the specialists fall back fallBackMm and resume after resumeAfterClearTicks clear. dig-ditch (Spademen, D5): a line of up to maxPoints the player draws, within withinZoneMm of the own zone, starting within startWithinMm of the regiment, at most mmPer10Soldiers per 10 soldiers long; profile: a 1-cell ditch ditchDepthMm below the ground, bermCells untouched, a 1-cell bank bankHeightMm high on the regiment's side; sectionCellsAlong cells per ticksPerSection with the whole regiment, scaled by living / starting soldiers but never below minRatePermille. fill-crossing (Fascine Carriers): triggered when the regiment's own foot path, within aheadMm of its officer, enters cells belowRimMm under the rim, mud of mudAtLeast or water waterMinMm to waterMaxMm deep; fills a strip widthCells wide, at most maxLengthCells long, through to the first cells open for wheeled, one bundle (bundleRaiseMm, up to the lower rim) per ticksPerBundle, one bundle per living soldier; filled cells lose their mud. A filled cell where depth x flow speed reaches washoutDepthSpeed (mm*m/s) for washoutTicks loses washoutLossMm. The fascine soil's churn (S2) waits for soils that change in battle. The Pontoon Train, Crossing Marshals, Engineers and Drovers join with bridges (M5 item 4) and herds (item 7).
